================ FILE: withFmtFix.js ================

const { withDangerousMod } = require('@expo/config-plugins');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const withMLKit = (config) => {
  return withDangerousMod(config, [
    'ios',
    async (config) => {
      const podfilePath = path.join(config.modRequest.platformProjectRoot, 'Podfile');
      let contents = fs.readFileSync(podfilePath, 'utf-8');

      // 1. Fix iOS deployment target for ML Kit
      contents = contents.replace(
        /platform :ios, podfile_properties\['ios.deploymentTarget'\] \|\| '.*'/,
        "platform :ios, '15.5'"
      );

      // 2. MLKit does not support arm64 simulator natively.
      // We must exclude arm64 on simulator and disable ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH so Xcode builds for x86_64 (Rosetta).
      const patch = `
    # ── FIX MLKIT FOR APPLE SILICON SIMULATORS (ROSETTA) ──
    installer.pods_project.targets.each do |target|
      target.build_configurations.each do |config|
        config.build_settings["ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]"] = "x86_64"
        config.build_settings["VALID_ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]"] = "x86_64"
        config.build_settings["ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH"] = "NO"
      end
    end
    main_project_path = File.join(__dir__, 'FinanceFlow.xcodeproj')
    main_project = Xcodeproj::Project.open(main_project_path)
    main_project.build_configurations.each do |config|
      config.build_settings["ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]"] = "x86_64"
      config.build_settings["VALID_ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]"] = "x86_64"
      config.build_settings["ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH"] = "NO"
    end
    main_project.save
    # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
`;
      contents = contents.replace(/post_install do \|installer\|/, "post_install do |installer|\n" + patch);

      const postIntegratePatch = `
post_integrate do |installer|
  # Fix fmt consteval bug directly in source since it ignores compiler flags
  fmt_base_h = File.join(installer.sandbox.root, 'fmt/include/fmt/base.h')
  if File.exist?(fmt_base_h)
    fmt_text = File.read(fmt_base_h)
    fmt_new = fmt_text.gsub(/#  define FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL 1/, "#  define FMT_USE_CONSTEVAL 0")
    File.write(fmt_base_h, fmt_new)
  end
end
`;
      contents = contents + "\n" + postIntegratePatch;

      fs.writeFileSync(podfilePath, contents);
      return config;
    },
  ]);
};

module.exports = withMLKit;


================ FILE: scripts/patch-touch-handler.js ================

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const filePath = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'node_modules', 'react-native', 'React', 'Fabric', 'RCTSurfaceTouchHandler.mm');

if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
  let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  const target = 'RCTAssert(iterator != _activeTouches.end(), @"Inconsistency between local and UIKit touch registries");';
  if (content.includes(target)) {
    content = content.split(target).join('// RCTAssert bypassed: guarded by if (iterator == _activeTouches.end()) continue; below');
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
    console.log('[patch-touch-handler] Successfully patched RCTSurfaceTouchHandler.mm');
  } else {
    console.log('[patch-touch-handler] RCTSurfaceTouchHandler.mm already patched or target not found.');
  }
} else {
  console.log('[patch-touch-handler] RCTSurfaceTouchHandler.mm does not exist (skip).');
}

import { Stack, useRouter, useSegments } from 'expo-router';
import { StatusBar } from 'expo-status-bar';
import { View, StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { AppProvider, useApp } from '../context/AppContext';
import { ThemeProvider, useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { Breakpoints } from '../constants/theme';
import {
    useFonts,
    Poppins_400Regular,
    Poppins_500Medium,
    Poppins_600SemiBold,
    Poppins_700Bold,
    Poppins_800ExtraBold,

import * as Notifications from 'expo-notifications';
import { logError } from '../services/errorLogger';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';

function AppContent() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const segments = useSegments();
    const { onboardingCompleted, loading } = useApp();
    const { colors, isDark } = useTheme();

    useEffect(() => {
        if (loading) return;
        const inOnboarding = segments[0] === 'onboarding';
        if (!onboardingCompleted && !inOnboarding) {
            router.replace('/onboarding');
        }
    }, [onboardingCompleted, loading]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const sub = Notifications.addNotificationResponseReceivedListener(response => {
            const data = response?.notification?.request?.content?.data;
            if (data?.type === 'savings_reminder' && data?.goalId) {
                router.push({
                    pathname: '/(tabs)/savings',
                    params: { addSavingGoalId: data.goalId }
                });
            } else if (data?.type === 'recurring_confirm' && data?.prefill) {
                router.push({
                    pathname: '/add-transaction',
                    params: { prefill: data.prefill }
                });
            }
        });
        return () => sub.remove();
    }, [router]);

    return (
        <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]}>
                <View style={[styles.content, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]}>
                    <StatusBar style={isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} />
                    <Stack
                        screenOptions={{
                            headerShown: false,
                            contentStyle: { backgroundColor: colors.background },
                            animation: 'slide_from_right',
                        }}
                    >
                        <Stack.Screen name="(tabs)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
                        <Stack.Screen name="onboarding" options={{ headerShown: false, animation: 'fade' }} />
                        <Stack.Screen
                            name="add-transaction"
                            options={{ presentation: 'modal', animation: 'slide_from_bottom', gestureEnabled: false }}
                        />
                        <Stack.Screen
                            name="chatbot"
                            options={{ presentation: 'modal', animation: 'slide_from_bottom', gestureEnabled: false }}
                        />
                        <Stack.Screen
                            name="settings"
                            options={{ presentation: 'card', animation: 'slide_from_right' }}
                        />
                        <Stack.Screen
                            name="log"
                            options={{ presentation: 'card', animation: 'slide_from_right' }}
                        />
                        <Stack.Screen
                            name="about"
                            options={{ presentation: 'card', animation: 'slide_from_right' }}
                        />
                        <Stack.Screen

                            options={{ presentation: 'modal', animation: 'slide_from_bottom', gestureEnabled: false }}

export default function RootLayout() {
    const [fontsLoaded] = useFonts({
        Poppins_400Regular,
        Poppins_500Medium,
        // Map heavier aliases to one-step lighter weights for a softer global typography.
        Poppins_600SemiBold: Poppins_500Medium,
        Poppins_700Bold: Poppins_600SemiBold,
        Poppins_800ExtraBold: Poppins_700Bold,
    });

    if (!fontsLoaded) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <ThemeProvider>
            <AppProvider>
                <AppContent />
            </AppProvider>
        </ThemeProvider>
    );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    container: {
        flex: 1,
        alignItems: 'center',
    },
    content: {
        flex: 1,
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: Breakpoints.tablet, // 768px max width
        overflow: 'hidden',
    },
});

export function ErrorBoundary({ error, retry }) {
    useEffect(() => {
        if (error) {
            logError(error, 'Global Error Boundary caught a rendering exception.');
        }
    }, [error]);

    return (
        <View style={[styles.container, { justifyContent: 'center', padding: 32, backgroundColor: '#f9fafb' }]}>
            <View style={{ width: 64, height: 64, borderRadius: 20, backgroundColor: '#fee2e2', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 24 }}>
                <Ionicons name="warning" size={32} color="#ef4444" />
            </View>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 22, fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold', color: '#111827', marginBottom: 12, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                Oops! Something went wrong.
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 14, fontFamily: 'Poppins_400Regular', color: '#4b5563', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 32, lineHeight: 22 }}>
                {error?.message || 'An unexpected rendering error occurred. The app prevented a total crash, but this screen failed to load.'}
            </Text>
            <TouchableOpacity
                style={{ backgroundColor: '#6366f1', paddingHorizontal: 32, paddingVertical: 16, borderRadius: 16, width: '100%', alignItems: 'center', shadowColor: '#6366f1', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.2, shadowRadius: 8, elevation: 4 }}
                onPress={retry}
                activeOpacity={0.8}
            >
                <Text style={{ color: 'white', fontFamily: 'Poppins_600SemiBold', fontSize: 16 }}>Reload Screen</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
    );
}

================ FILE: app/(tabs)/index.js ================

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, Alert, View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, useWindowDimensions } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { formatCurrency } from '../../utils/currencies';
import { filterTransactionsByPeriod, groupByCategory, formatTime } from '../../utils/helpers';
import { getCategoryById, getAccountTypeById } from '../../utils/categories';
import { getSavingReminderRecommendations } from '../../utils/savings';
import { Spacing, FontSize, BorderRadius } from '../../constants/theme';

const DEFAULT_COLORS = ['#ff6600', '#1E3A8A', '#1E293B', '#065F46', '#7C3AED', '#9D174D'];

function getCardColor(asset, index) {
    return asset.color || DEFAULT_COLORS[index % DEFAULT_COLORS.length];
}

export default function Dashboard() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { transactions, budgets, assets, savingsGoals, currency, loading, currentDateKey, deleteTransaction, updateAsset, exchangeRates, convertCurrency } = useApp();
    const { colors, isDark } = useTheme();
    const [showBalance, setShowBalance] = useState(true);
    const [showMore, setShowMore] = useState(false);
    const [spendingTab, setSpendingTab] = useState('recent');
    const [selectedAssetId, setSelectedAssetId] = useState(null);
    const [expandedTxId, setExpandedTxId] = useState(null);

    const assetCurrencies = useMemo(
        () => [...new Set(assets.map(a => a.currency || currency))],
        [assets, currency]
    );
    const hasMixedAssetCurrencies = assetCurrencies.length > 1;
    const totalAssetValue = useMemo(
        () => assets.reduce((sum, a) => sum + convertCurrency(a.balance || 0, a.currency || currency, currency, exchangeRates), 0),
        [assets, currency, exchangeRates]
    );
    const monthlyTx = useMemo(() => filterTransactionsByPeriod(transactions, 'monthly'), [transactions, currentDateKey]);
    const todayTx = useMemo(() => filterTransactionsByPeriod(transactions, 'daily'), [transactions, currentDateKey]);

    const totalIncome = monthlyTx.filter(t => t.type === 'income').reduce((s, t) => s + Math.abs(convertCurrency(t.amount || 0, t.currency || currency, currency, exchangeRates)), 0);
    const totalSpending = monthlyTx.filter(t => t.type === 'spending').reduce((s, t) => s + Math.abs(convertCurrency(t.amount || 0, t.currency || currency, currency, exchangeRates)), 0);
    const balance = totalIncome - totalSpending;
    const todayIncome = todayTx.filter(t => t.type === 'income').reduce((s, t) => s + Math.abs(convertCurrency(t.amount || 0, t.currency || currency, currency, exchangeRates)), 0);
    const todaySpending = todayTx.filter(t => t.type === 'spending').reduce((s, t) => s + Math.abs(convertCurrency(t.amount || 0, t.currency || currency, currency, exchangeRates)), 0);

    const activeBudget = budgets[0] || null;
    let dailyBudget = 0;
    if (activeBudget) {
        if (activeBudget.period === 'daily') dailyBudget = activeBudget.amount;
        else if (activeBudget.period === 'weekly') dailyBudget = activeBudget.amount / 7;
        else { const now = new Date(); dailyBudget = activeBudget.amount / new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate(); }
    }
    const dailyBudgetRemaining = dailyBudget - todaySpending;

    const displayedAssets = assets.slice(0, 3);
    const showMoreAssetsBtn = assets.length > 5;
    const recentTransactions = transactions.slice(0, 6);
    const topCategories = Object.entries(groupByCategory(monthlyTx.filter(t => t.type === 'spending'), (t) => convertCurrency(t.amount, t.currency || currency, currency, exchangeRates)))
        .map(([id, data]) => {
            const catInfo = getCategoryById(id);
            return { ...catInfo, id: catInfo.id, total: data.total };
        })
        .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total).slice(0, 6);
    const savingsRecommendations = useMemo(() => getSavingReminderRecommendations(savingsGoals).slice(0, 3), [savingsGoals]);

    const confirmDeleteTx = (transaction) => {
        if (transaction.type === 'move' && transaction.fromAssetId && transaction.toAssetId) {
            const fromAsset = assets.find(a => a.id === transaction.fromAssetId);
            const toAsset = assets.find(a => a.id === transaction.toAssetId);
            if (fromAsset && toAsset) {
                Alert.alert(
                    'Delete Transfer',
                    `Do you want to reverse this transfer and return ${formatCurrency(Math.abs(transaction.amount), currency)} from "${toAsset.name}" back to "${fromAsset.name}"?`,
                    [
                        { text: 'No, just delete', style: 'default', onPress: () => deleteTransaction(transaction.id) },
                        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                        {
                            text: 'Yes, reverse transfer',
                            style: 'default',
                            onPress: async () => {
                                await deleteTransaction(transaction.id);
                                await updateAsset({ ...fromAsset, balance: (fromAsset.balance || 0) + Math.abs(transaction.amount) });
                                await updateAsset({ ...toAsset, balance: (toAsset.balance || 0) - Math.abs(transaction.amount) });
                            },
                        },
                    ]
                );
                return;
            }
        }

        const linkedAsset = transaction.assetId ? assets.find(a => a.id === transaction.assetId) : null;
        if (linkedAsset) {
            const isSpending = transaction.type === 'spending';
            Alert.alert(
                'Delete Transaction',
                `Return ${formatCurrency(Math.abs(transaction.amount), currency)} ${isSpending ? 'back to' : 'from'} "${linkedAsset.name}"?`,
                [
                    { text: 'No, just delete', onPress: () => deleteTransaction(transaction.id) },
                    { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                    {
                        text: 'Yes, restore',
                        onPress: async () => {
                            await deleteTransaction(transaction.id);
                            const delta = isSpending ? Math.abs(transaction.amount) : -Math.abs(transaction.amount);
                            await updateAsset({ ...linkedAsset, balance: (linkedAsset.balance || 0) + delta });
                        },
                    },
                ]
            );
        } else {
            Alert.alert('Delete Transaction', 'Delete this transaction?', [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { text: 'Delete', style: 'destructive', onPress: () => deleteTransaction(transaction.id) },
            ]);
        }
    };

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <View style={[{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: colors.background, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }]}>
                <Text style={{ color: colors.primary, fontSize: FontSize.md, fontFamily: 'Poppins_400Regular' }}>Loading…</Text>
            </View>
        );
    }

    const renderAssetCard = (asset, index) => {
        const isSelected = selectedAssetId === asset.id;
        const cardColor = getCardColor(asset, index);
        const typeInfo = getAccountTypeById(asset.type);
        return (
            <TouchableOpacity key={asset.id} activeOpacity={0.88}
                onPress={() => setSelectedAssetId(isSelected ? null : asset.id)}
                style={[styles.atmCard, { backgroundColor: cardColor }, isSelected ? styles.atmCardExpanded : styles.atmCardCollapsed]}>
                {isSelected ? (
                    <>
                        <View style={styles.atmTop}>
                            <View style={styles.atmChip}><View style={styles.atmChipLine1} /><View style={styles.atmChipLine2} /></View>
                            <Ionicons name={typeInfo.icon} size={22} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)" />
                        </View>
                        <Text style={styles.atmName} numberOfLines={1}>{asset.name}</Text>
                        <Text style={styles.atmBalance}>{showBalance ? formatCurrency(asset.balance || 0, asset.currency || currency) : '••••••'}</Text>
                        <View style={styles.atmFooter}>
                            <Text style={styles.atmTypeName}>{typeInfo.name}</Text>
                            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.atmEditChip} onPress={() => router.push('/assets')}>
                                <Ionicons name="create-outline" size={12} color="#fff" />
                                <Text style={styles.atmEditChipTxt}>Edit</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        </View>
                    </>
                ) : (
                    <View style={styles.atmCollapsedRow}>
                        <View style={styles.atmCollapsedLeft}>
                            <View style={styles.atmChipTiny} />
                            <View style={styles.atmCollapsedIcon}><Ionicons name={typeInfo.icon} size={14} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.7)" /></View>
                            <Text style={styles.atmCollapsedName} numberOfLines={1}>{asset.name}</Text>
                        </View>
                        <Text style={styles.atmCollapsedBal}>{showBalance ? formatCurrency(asset.balance || 0, asset.currency || currency) : '••••'}</Text>
                    </View>
                )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
        );
    };

    // Dynamic styles that depend on theme
    const bg = colors.background;
    const cardBg = colors.card;
    const textPrimary = colors.text;
    const textSec = colors.textSecondary;
    const textMuted = colors.textMuted;
    const purple = colors.primary;
    const purpleLight = colors.primaryLight;
    const border = colors.border;

    return (
        <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: bg }]}>
            <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
                {/* ── Hero section ── */}
                <View style={styles.heroSection}>
                    <View style={styles.heroTopRow}>
                        <Text style={[styles.heroLabel, { color: textSec }]}>Total Asset Value</Text>
                        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.settingsBtn, { backgroundColor: purpleLight }]} onPress={() => router.push('/settings')}>
                            <Ionicons name="settings-outline" size={20} color={purple} />
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.heroValueRow} onPress={() => setShowBalance(v => !v)} activeOpacity={0.75}>
                        <Text style={[styles.heroValue, { color: textPrimary }]}>
                            {showBalance
                                ? formatCurrency(totalAssetValue, currency)
                                : '••••••'}
                        </Text>
                        <Ionicons name={showBalance ? 'eye-outline' : 'eye-off-outline'} size={22} color={textMuted} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    {hasMixedAssetCurrencies && showBalance && (
                        <Text style={[styles.currencyWarning, { color: textMuted }]}>
                            Converted to {currency} · accounts in {assetCurrencies.join(', ')}
                        </Text>
                    )}
                    <Text style={[styles.budgetSignal, { color: dailyBudgetRemaining >= 0 ? '#0d9488' : '#dc2626' }]}>
                        Daily budget: {formatCurrency(dailyBudgetRemaining, currency)}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.todayIncome, { color: textSec }]}>
                        Today's income: <Text style={{ color: '#059669', fontFamily: 'Poppins_600SemiBold' }}>{formatCurrency(todayIncome, currency)}</Text>
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.todaySpending, { color: textSec }]}>
                        Today's spending: <Text style={{ color: '#dc2626', fontFamily: 'Poppins_600SemiBold' }}>{formatCurrency(todaySpending, currency)}</Text>
                    </Text>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.moreToggle, { backgroundColor: purpleLight }]} onPress={() => setShowMore(v => !v)}>
                        <Text style={[styles.moreToggleTxt, { color: purple }]}>More</Text>
                        <Ionicons name={showMore ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} size={14} color={purple} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    {showMore && (
                        <View style={styles.statsGrid}>
                            {[
                                { label: 'Income', value: `+${formatCurrency(totalIncome, currency)}`, color: '#059669' },
                                { label: 'Spending', value: `-${formatCurrency(totalSpending, currency)}`, color: '#dc2626' },
                                { label: 'Balance', value: formatCurrency(balance, currency), color: balance >= 0 ? '#059669' : '#dc2626' },
                                { label: 'Daily Budget', value: formatCurrency(dailyBudget, currency), color: purple },
                            ].map(s => (
                                <View key={s.label} style={[styles.statCard, { backgroundColor: cardBg, borderColor: border }]}>
                                    <Text style={[styles.statLabel, { color: textMuted }]}>{s.label}</Text>
                                    <Text style={[styles.statValue, { color: s.color }]}>{s.value}</Text>
                                </View>
                            ))}
                        </View>
                    )}
                </View>

                {(assets.length === 0 || transactions.length === 0 || budgets.length === 0) && (
                    <View style={[styles.getStartedCard, { backgroundColor: cardBg, borderColor: `${purple}33` }]}>
                        <View style={styles.getStartedHeader}>
                            <Ionicons name="compass-outline" size={17} color={purple} />
                            <Text style={[styles.getStartedTitle, { color: textPrimary }]}>Getting started</Text>
                        </View>
                        {assets.length === 0 && (
                            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.getStartedRow} onPress={() => router.push('/assets')}>
                                <Ionicons name="card-outline" size={16} color={purple} />
                                <Text style={[styles.getStartedText, { color: textSec }]}>Add your first account</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        )}
                        {transactions.length === 0 && (
                            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.getStartedRow} onPress={() => router.push('/add-transaction')}>
                                <Ionicons name="add-circle-outline" size={16} color={purple} />
                                <Text style={[styles.getStartedText, { color: textSec }]}>Add or scan your first transaction</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        )}
                        {budgets.length === 0 && (
                            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.getStartedRow} onPress={() => router.push('/budget')}>
                                <Ionicons name="flag-outline" size={16} color={purple} />
                                <Text style={[styles.getStartedText, { color: textSec }]}>Set a spending budget</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        )}
                    </View>
                )}

                {/* Savings recommendations */}
                {savingsRecommendations.length > 0 && (
                    <View style={[styles.recommendCard, { backgroundColor: cardBg, borderColor: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.2)' }]}>
                        <View style={styles.recommendHeader}>
                            <Ionicons name="notifications-outline" size={16} color="#F59E0B" />
                            <Text style={[styles.recommendTitle, { color: '#B45309' }]}>Recommendations</Text>
                        </View>
                        {savingsRecommendations.map(item => (
                            <View key={item.goalId} style={styles.recommendRow}>
                                <View style={styles.recommendDot} />
                                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                    <Text style={[styles.recommendGoal, { color: textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>{item.title}</Text>
                                    <Text style={[styles.recommendText, { color: textMuted }]}>{item.message}</Text>
                                </View>
                            </View>
                        ))}
                        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.recommendBtn, { backgroundColor: purpleLight }]} onPress={() => router.push('/savings')}>
                            <Text style={[styles.recommendBtnTxt, { color: purple }]}>Add Savings Now</Text>
                            <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={14} color={purple} />
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                )}

                {/* Assets */}
                <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
                    <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: textPrimary }]}>Assets</Text>
                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.push('/assets')}>
                        <Text style={[styles.linkText, { color: purple }]}>See all</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.atmList}>
                    {assets.length === 0 ? (
                        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.emptyAssetsCard, { backgroundColor: cardBg, borderColor: `${purple}33` }]} onPress={() => router.push('/assets')}>
                            <Ionicons name="add-circle-outline" size={30} color={purple} />
                            <Text style={[styles.emptyAssetsTxt, { color: purple }]}>Add your first account</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    ) : displayedAssets.map((a, i) => renderAssetCard(a, i))}
                    {showMoreAssetsBtn && (
                        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.moreAssetsBtn, { backgroundColor: purpleLight }]} onPress={() => router.push('/assets')}>
                            <Text style={[styles.moreAssetsBtnTxt, { color: purple }]}>+{assets.length - 3} more accounts →</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                </View>

                {/* Shortcuts */}
                <View style={styles.shortcutsRow}>
                    {[
                        { id: 'scan', title: 'Scan', icon: 'camera-outline', route: '/receipt-scanner' },
                        { id: 'health', title: 'AI Health', icon: 'heart-outline', route: '/financial-health' },
                        { id: 'ai', title: 'AI Chat', icon: 'chatbubble-ellipses-outline', route: '/chatbot' },
                        { id: 'vehicles', title: 'My Vehicles', icon: 'car-sport-outline', route: '/vehicles' },
                    ].map(item => (
                        <TouchableOpacity key={item.id} style={styles.shortcutItem} onPress={() => router.push(item.route)}>
                            <View style={[styles.shortcutIconWrap, { backgroundColor: cardBg, borderColor: border }]}>
                                <Ionicons name={item.icon} size={22} color={purple} />
                            </View>
                            <Text style={[styles.shortcutTxt, { color: textSec }]}>{item.title}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </View>

                {/* My Spending */}
                <View style={[styles.sectionHeaderAlt]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: textPrimary }]}>My Spending</Text>
                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.push('/transactions')}>
                        <Text style={[styles.linkText, { color: purple }]}>View all</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
                <View style={[styles.segmentWrap, { backgroundColor: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)' }]}>
                    {['recent', 'top'].map(tab => (
                        <TouchableOpacity key={tab}
                            style={[styles.segmentBtn, spendingTab === tab && [styles.segmentBtnActive, { backgroundColor: isDark ? colors.surface : '#FFFFFF' }]]}
                            onPress={() => setSpendingTab(tab)}>
                            <Text style={[styles.segmentTxt, { color: textMuted }, spendingTab === tab && { color: purple, fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold' }]}>
                                {tab === 'recent' ? 'Recent' : 'Top Categories'}
                            </Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </View>
                <View style={styles.listWrap}>
                    {spendingTab === 'recent' ? (
                        recentTransactions.length === 0
                            ? <View style={styles.emptyList}><Text style={[styles.emptyListTxt, { color: textMuted }]}>No recent transactions</Text></View>
                            : recentTransactions.map(tx => {
                                let cat = tx.type === 'move' ? { name: 'Transfer', icon: 'swap-horizontal', color: '#6A6FF8' } : getCategoryById(tx.category);
                                if (tx.vehicleLogType === 'refuel') cat = { ...cat, name: 'Car Refuel' };
                                if (tx.vehicleLogType === 'maintenance') cat = { ...cat, name: 'Car Maintenance' };
                                const income = tx.type === 'income';
                                const expanded = expandedTxId === tx.id;
                                const amtColor = tx.type === 'move' ? '#6A6FF8' : income ? '#059669' : '#dc2626';
                                const txOriginalCur = tx.currency || currency;
                                const originalAmt = formatCurrency(Math.abs(tx.amount), txOriginalCur);
                                const hasDiffCurrency = txOriginalCur !== currency;
                                const baseAmt = hasDiffCurrency ? formatCurrency(Math.abs(convertCurrency(tx.amount, txOriginalCur, currency, exchangeRates)), currency) : null;
                                return (
                                    <TouchableOpacity
                                        key={tx.id}
                                        style={[styles.txCard, { backgroundColor: cardBg }]}
                                        onPress={() => setExpandedTxId(expanded ? null : tx.id)}
                                        activeOpacity={0.82}
                                    >
                                        <View style={styles.txMain}>
                                            <View style={[styles.txIcon, { backgroundColor: `${cat.color}18` }]}>
                                                <Ionicons name={cat.icon} size={20} color={cat.color} />
                                            </View>
                                            <View style={styles.txInfo}>
                                                <Text style={[styles.txName, { color: textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>{tx.description || cat.name}</Text>
                                                <Text style={[styles.txMeta, { color: textMuted }]}>{cat.name} · {formatTime(tx.date)}</Text>
                                            </View>
                                            <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
                                                <Text style={[styles.txAmount, { color: amtColor }]}>
                                                    {tx.type === 'move' ? '⇄ ' : income ? '+' : '-'}{originalAmt}
                                                </Text>
                                                {hasDiffCurrency && (
                                                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
                                                        {baseAmt}
                                                    </Text>
                                                )}
                                            </View>
                                        </View>
                                        {expanded && (
                                            <View style={styles.txExpanded}>
                                                <View style={[styles.txExpandedDivider, { backgroundColor: border }]} />
                                                <Text style={[styles.txDetail, { color: textSec }]}>📅 {tx.date ? new Date(tx.date).toLocaleDateString() : ''}</Text>
                                                <View style={styles.txActions}>
                                                    <TouchableOpacity
                                                        style={styles.editBtn}
                                                        onPress={() => router.push({ pathname: '/add-transaction', params: { editId: tx.id } })}
                                                    >
                                                        <Ionicons name="pencil" size={14} color="#6A6FF8" />
                                                        <Text style={styles.editTxt}>Edit</Text>
                                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.deleteBtn} onPress={() => confirmDeleteTx(tx)}>
                                                        <Ionicons name="trash" size={14} color="#dc2626" />
                                                        <Text style={styles.deleteTxt}>Delete</Text>
                                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                                </View>
                                            </View>
                                        )}
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                );
                            })
                    ) : (
                        topCategories.length === 0
                            ? <View style={styles.emptyList}><Text style={[styles.emptyListTxt, { color: textMuted }]}>No category spending yet</Text></View>
                            : topCategories.map(cat => (
                                <TouchableOpacity
                                    key={cat.id}
                                    style={[styles.txCard, { backgroundColor: cardBg }]}
                                    activeOpacity={0.75}
                                    onPress={() => router.push({
                                        pathname: '/category-transactions',
                                        params: {
                                            category: cat.id,
                                            period: 'monthly',
                                            refDate: new Date().toISOString(),
                                        }
                                    })}
                                >
                                    <View style={styles.txMain}>
                                        <View style={[styles.txIcon, { backgroundColor: `${cat.color}18` }]}><Ionicons name={cat.icon} size={20} color={cat.color} /></View>
                                        <View style={styles.txInfo}>
                                            <Text style={[styles.txName, { color: textPrimary }]}>{cat.name}</Text>
                                            <Text style={[styles.txMeta, { color: textMuted }]}>Top category · Tap to view</Text>
                                        </View>
                                        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                                            <Text style={[styles.txAmount, { color: '#dc2626' }]}>-{formatCurrency(Math.abs(cat.total), currency)}</Text>
                                            <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={16} color={textMuted} />
                                        </View>
                                    </View>
                                </TouchableOpacity>
                            ))
                    )}
                </View>
                <View style={{ height: 100 }} />
            </ScrollView>
        </View>
    );
}

    scrollContent: { paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg, paddingTop: 64 },

    getStartedTitle: { fontSize: FontSize.md, fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold' },
    getStartedRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: Spacing.sm, paddingVertical: 8 },
    getStartedText: { fontSize: FontSize.sm, fontFamily: 'Poppins_500Medium' },
    sectionHeader: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: Spacing.md },
    sectionHeaderAlt: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginTop: Spacing.xl, marginBottom: Spacing.md },
    sectionTitle: { fontSize: FontSize.xl, fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold' },
    linkText: { fontSize: FontSize.sm, fontFamily: 'Poppins_500Medium' },
    atmList: { gap: Spacing.sm, marginBottom: Spacing.xl },
    atmCard: { borderRadius: 18, overflow: 'hidden', shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.22, shadowRadius: 12, elevation: Platform.OS === 'android' ? 0 : 6 },

    atmCardCollapsed: { paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg, paddingVertical: Spacing.md },

    atmEditChip: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)', paddingHorizontal: Spacing.md, paddingVertical: 5, borderRadius: BorderRadius.full },
    atmEditChipTxt: { color: '#fff', fontSize: FontSize.xs, fontFamily: 'Poppins_600SemiBold' },
    atmCollapsedRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' },
    atmCollapsedLeft: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flex: 1 },

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Platform, View, Text, ScrollView, FlatList, TouchableOpacity, TextInput, StyleSheet, Modal, Alert, useWindowDimensions } from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Defs, LinearGradient as SvgGrad, Stop, Rect } from 'react-native-svg';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { format, addDays, subDays, addWeeks, subWeeks, addMonths, subMonths } from 'date-fns';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { formatCurrency } from '../../utils/currencies';
import { filterTransactionsByPeriod, formatDate, formatTime, getDateRange } from '../../utils/helpers';
import { getCategoryById, spendingCategories, incomeCategories } from '../../utils/categories';
import { Colors, Spacing, FontSize, BorderRadius } from '../../constants/theme';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

function DatePickerModal({ visible, value, onConfirm, onClose, colors }) {
    const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
    const [month, setMonth] = useState(0);
    const [day, setDay] = useState(1);
    const [year, setYear] = useState(new Date().getFullYear());

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!visible) return;
        const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
        setMonth(date.getMonth());
        setDay(date.getDate());
        setYear(date.getFullYear());
    }, [visible, value]);

    const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();

    const handleConfirm = () => {
        onConfirm(new Date(year, month, Math.min(day, daysInMonth)));
        onClose();
    };

    return (
        <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade">
            <View style={[styles.dpOverlay, { backgroundColor: colors.overlay }]}>
                <View style={[styles.dpBox, { backgroundColor: colors.modalBg }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.dpTitle, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>Select Date</Text>
                    <View style={styles.dpRow}>
                        {[
                            { label: 'Month', value: months[month], up: () => setMonth((month + 1) % 12), down: () => setMonth((month + 11) % 12) },
                            { label: 'Day', value: day, up: () => setDay(day >= daysInMonth ? 1 : day + 1), down: () => setDay(day <= 1 ? daysInMonth : day - 1) },
                            { label: 'Year', value: year, up: () => setYear(year + 1), down: () => setYear(year - 1) },
                        ].map((f, i) => (
                            <View key={i} style={styles.dpField}>
                                <Text style={styles.dpFieldLabel}>{f.label}</Text>
                                <TouchableOpacity onPress={f.up}><Ionicons name="chevron-up" size={22} color={colors.primary} /></TouchableOpacity>
                                <Text style={[styles.dpFieldValue, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>{String(f.value).padStart(2, '0')}</Text>
                                <TouchableOpacity onPress={f.down}><Ionicons name="chevron-down" size={22} color={colors.primary} /></TouchableOpacity>
                            </View>
                        ))}
                    </View>
                    <View style={styles.dpBtnRow}>
                        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.dpCancel, { backgroundColor: colors.primaryLight }]} onPress={onClose}>
                            <Text style={styles.dpCancelText}>Cancel</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.dpConfirm, { backgroundColor: colors.primary }]} onPress={handleConfirm}>
                            <Text style={styles.dpConfirmText}>Confirm</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                </View>
            </View>
        </Modal>
    );
}

export default function Transactions() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { colors, isDark } = useTheme();
    const { transactions, assets, currency, deleteTransaction, updateAsset, exchangeRates, convertCurrency } = useApp();
    const [period, setPeriod] = useState('daily');
    const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState('newest');
    const [refDate, setRefDate] = useState(new Date());
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState(null);
    const [showDateModal, setShowDateModal] = useState(false);
    const [showSummaryModal, setShowSummaryModal] = useState(null); // 'income' | 'spending' | null
    const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);
    const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState('all'); // 'all' | 'income' | 'spending' | 'move'
    const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState([]);
    const [amountMin, setAmountMin] = useState('');
    const [amountMax, setAmountMax] = useState('');
    const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = useWindowDimensions();

    const allCategories = useMemo(() => [...spendingCategories, ...incomeCategories], []);

    const activeFilterCount = useMemo(() => {
        let count = 0;
        if (typeFilter !== 'all') count++;
        if (categoryFilter.length > 0) count++;
        if (amountMin || amountMax) count++;
        return count;
    }, [typeFilter, categoryFilter, amountMin, amountMax]);

    const clearAllFilters = () => {
        setTypeFilter('all');
        setCategoryFilter([]);
        setAmountMin('');
        setAmountMax('');
    };

    const navigate = (direction) => {
        if (period === 'all') return;
        const fn = direction === 'next'
            ? (period === 'daily' ? addDays : period === 'weekly' ? addWeeks : addMonths)
            : (period === 'daily' ? subDays : period === 'weekly' ? subWeeks : subMonths);
        setRefDate(fn(refDate, 1));
    };

    const filtered = useMemo(() => {
        let periodTransactions = period === 'all'
            ? [...transactions]
            : filterTransactionsByPeriod(transactions, period, refDate);

        if (search.trim()) {
            const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
            periodTransactions = periodTransactions.filter((transaction) => {
                let category = transaction.type === 'move'
                    ? { name: 'Transfer' }
                    : getCategoryById(transaction.category);
                if (transaction.vehicleLogType === 'refuel') category = { ...category, name: 'Car Refuel' };
                if (transaction.vehicleLogType === 'maintenance') category = { ...category, name: 'Car Maintenance' };

                return (
                    (transaction.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
                    (category?.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
                    (transaction.items || []).some(item => String(item?.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(query))
                );
            });
        }

        // Advanced filters
        if (typeFilter !== 'all') {
            periodTransactions = periodTransactions.filter(t => t.type === typeFilter);
        }
        if (categoryFilter.length > 0) {
            periodTransactions = periodTransactions.filter(t => categoryFilter.includes(t.category));
        }
        if (amountMin) {
            const min = parseFloat(amountMin);
            if (!isNaN(min)) periodTransactions = periodTransactions.filter(t => Math.abs(t.amount) >= min);
        }
        if (amountMax) {
            const max = parseFloat(amountMax);
            if (!isNaN(max)) periodTransactions = periodTransactions.filter(t => Math.abs(t.amount) <= max);
        }


        const sortedTransactions = [...periodTransactions];
        sortedTransactions.sort((a, b) => {
            const dateA = new Date(a?.date).getTime() || 0;
            const dateB = new Date(b?.date).getTime() || 0;
            const amountA = Math.abs(Number(a?.amount) || 0);
            const amountB = Math.abs(Number(b?.amount) || 0);
            if (sortBy === 'oldest') return dateA - dateB;
            if (sortBy === 'amount_high') return amountB - amountA;
            if (sortBy === 'amount_low') return amountA - amountB;
            return dateB - dateA;
        });

        return sortedTransactions;
    }, [transactions, period, refDate, search, sortBy, typeFilter, categoryFilter, amountMin, amountMax]);

    const periodLabel = useMemo(() => {
        if (period === 'all') return 'All time';
        if (period === 'daily') return format(refDate, 'MMM dd, yyyy');
        const { start, end } = getDateRange(period, refDate);
        return `${format(start, 'MMM dd, yyyy')} - ${format(end, 'MMM dd, yyyy')}`;
    }, [period, refDate]);

    const sortOptions = [
        { value: 'newest', label: 'Newest' },
        { value: 'oldest', label: 'Oldest' },
        { value: 'amount_high', label: 'Highest' },
        { value: 'amount_low', label: 'Lowest' },
    ];

    const totalIncome = filtered
        .filter((t) => t.type === 'income')
        .reduce((sum, t) => sum + Math.abs(convertCurrency(t.amount, t.currency || currency, currency, exchangeRates)), 0);

    const totalSpending = filtered
        .filter((t) => t.type === 'spending')
        .reduce((sum, t) => sum + Math.abs(convertCurrency(t.amount, t.currency || currency, currency, exchangeRates)), 0);

    const confirmDelete = (transaction) => {
        if (transaction.type === 'move' && transaction.fromAssetId && transaction.toAssetId) {
            const fromAsset = assets.find(a => a.id === transaction.fromAssetId);
            const toAsset = assets.find(a => a.id === transaction.toAssetId);
            if (fromAsset && toAsset) {
                Alert.alert(
                    'Delete Transfer',
                    `Do you want to reverse this transfer and return ${formatCurrency(Math.abs(transaction.amount), currency)} from "${toAsset.name}" back to "${fromAsset.name}"?`,
                    [
                        { text: 'No, just delete', style: 'default', onPress: () => deleteTransaction(transaction.id) },
                        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                        {
                            text: 'Yes, reverse transfer',
                            style: 'default',
                            onPress: async () => {
                                await deleteTransaction(transaction.id);
                                await updateAsset({ ...fromAsset, balance: (fromAsset.balance || 0) + Math.abs(transaction.amount) });
                                await updateAsset({ ...toAsset, balance: (toAsset.balance || 0) - Math.abs(transaction.amount) });
                            },
                        },
                    ]
                );
                return;
            }
        }

        const linkedAsset = transaction.assetId ? assets.find(a => a.id === transaction.assetId) : null;

        if (linkedAsset) {
            // Transaction was paid from/to an asset — ask about reversal
            const isSpending = transaction.type === 'spending';
            const verb = isSpending ? 'return' : 'deduct';
            const direction = isSpending ? 'back to' : 'from';
            Alert.alert(
                'Delete Transaction',
                `Do you want to ${verb} ${formatCurrency(Math.abs(transaction.amount), currency)} ${direction} "${linkedAsset.name}"?`,
                [
                    {
                        text: 'No, just delete',
                        style: 'default',
                        onPress: () => deleteTransaction(transaction.id),
                    },
                    {
                        text: 'Cancel',
                        style: 'cancel',
                    },
                    {
                        text: 'Yes, restore',
                        style: 'default',
                        onPress: async () => {
                            await deleteTransaction(transaction.id);
                            // Restore: spending → add back, income → deduct
                            const delta = isSpending ? Math.abs(transaction.amount) : -Math.abs(transaction.amount);
                            await updateAsset({ ...linkedAsset, balance: (linkedAsset.balance || 0) + delta });
                        },
                    },
                ]
            );
        } else {
            Alert.alert('Delete Transaction', 'Delete this transaction?', [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { text: 'Delete', style: 'destructive', onPress: () => deleteTransaction(transaction.id) },
            ]);
        }
    };

    const getCurrencyBreakdown = (type) => {
        const txs = filtered.filter(t => t.type === type);
        const breakdown = {};
        txs.forEach(t => {
            const txCur = t.currency || currency;
            if (!breakdown[txCur]) breakdown[txCur] = { originalTotal: 0, convertedTotal: 0 };
            breakdown[txCur].originalTotal += Math.abs(t.amount);
            breakdown[txCur].convertedTotal += Math.abs(convertCurrency(t.amount, txCur, currency, exchangeRates));
        });
        return Object.entries(breakdown).map(([cur, data]) => ({ cur, ...data })).sort((a, b) => b.convertedTotal - a.convertedTotal);
    };

    const summaryBreakdown = showSummaryModal ? getCurrencyBreakdown(showSummaryModal) : [];
    const summaryTotal = summaryBreakdown.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.convertedTotal, 0);

    return (
        <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]}>
            {/* Gradient background */}
            <Svg key={colors.background} style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject} width={screenWidth} height={screenHeight} pointerEvents="none">
                <Defs>
                    <SvgGrad id="bgGrad" x1="0.2" y1="0" x2="0.8" y2="1">
                        <Stop offset="0" stopColor={colors.gradientStart} stopOpacity="1" />
                        <Stop offset="0.5" stopColor={colors.gradientMid} stopOpacity="1" />
                        <Stop offset="1" stopColor={colors.gradientEnd} stopOpacity="1" />
                    </SvgGrad>
                </Defs>
                <Rect x="0" y="0" width={screenWidth} height={screenHeight} fill="url(#bgGrad)" />
            </Svg>

            {/* Header */}
            <View style={styles.header}>
                <Text style={[styles.title, { color: colors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>Transaction History</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.calendarBtn, { backgroundColor: colors.primaryLight }]}
                    onPress={() => router.push('/calendar-view')}
                    activeOpacity={0.75}
                    accessibilityLabel="Spending Calendar"
                >
                    <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={20} color={colors.primary} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {/* Period Tabs */}
            <View style={styles.periodTabsWrap}>
                <View style={[styles.periodTabs, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border }]}>
                    {['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'all'].map((tabPeriod) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                            key={tabPeriod}
                            style={[
                                styles.periodTab,
                                period === tabPeriod && [styles.periodTabActive, { backgroundColor: colors.primary, shadowColor: colors.primary }]
                            ]}
                            onPress={() => { setPeriod(tabPeriod); setRefDate(new Date()); }}
                            activeOpacity={0.75}
                        >
                            <Text style={[
                                styles.periodText,
                                { color: colors.textMuted },
                                period === tabPeriod && styles.periodTextActive
                            ]}>
                                {tabPeriod === 'all' ? 'All Time' : tabPeriod.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + tabPeriod.slice(1)}
                            </Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </View>
            </View>

            {/* Date Navigator */}
            {period === 'all' ? (
                <View style={styles.allTimeBanner}>
                    <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={14} color={colors.textSecondary} />
                    <Text style={[styles.allTimeText, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Showing all transactions</Text>
                </View>
            ) : (
                <View style={styles.dateNav}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.navArrow, { backgroundColor: colors.primaryLight }]} onPress={() => navigate('prev')}>
                        <Ionicons name="chevron-back" size={18} color={colors.primary} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.dateLabelWrap, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border }]} onPress={() => setShowDateModal(true)}>
                        <Text style={[styles.dateLabel, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>{periodLabel}</Text>
                        <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={14} color={colors.primary} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.navArrow, { backgroundColor: colors.primaryLight }]} onPress={() => navigate('next')}>
                        <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color={colors.primary} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
            )}

            {/* Totals Card */}
            <View style={[styles.totalsCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border, shadowColor: isDark ? '#000' : '#1A1040' }]}>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.totalItem} onPress={() => setShowSummaryModal('income')} activeOpacity={0.7}>
                    <Text style={styles.totalAmountIncome}>+{formatCurrency(totalIncome, currency)}</Text>
                    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                        <Text style={styles.totalLabel}>Income</Text>
                        <Ionicons name="information-circle-outline" size={14} color={colors.textMuted} />
                    </View>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <View style={styles.totalDivider} />
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.totalItem} onPress={() => setShowSummaryModal('spending')} activeOpacity={0.7}>
                    <Text style={styles.totalAmountSpending}>-{formatCurrency(totalSpending, currency)}</Text>
                    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                        <Text style={styles.totalLabel}>Spending</Text>
                        <Ionicons name="information-circle-outline" size={14} color={colors.textMuted} />
                    </View>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {/* Search */}
            <View style={styles.searchRow}>
                <View style={[styles.searchBox, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border }]}>
                    <Ionicons name="search" size={16} color={colors.textSecondary} />
                    <TextInput
                        style={[styles.searchInput, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}
                        placeholder="Search transactions..."
                        placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
                        value={search}
                        onChangeText={setSearch}
                    />
                    {search ? (
                        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearch('')}>
                            <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color={colors.textSecondary} />
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    ) : null}
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.filterToggle, { backgroundColor: showFilters || activeFilterCount > 0 ? colors.primaryLight : colors.card, borderColor: activeFilterCount > 0 ? colors.primary : colors.border }]}
                    onPress={() => setShowFilters(!showFilters)}
                >
                    <Ionicons name="options-outline" size={18} color={activeFilterCount > 0 ? colors.primary : colors.textSecondary} />
                    {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
                        <View style={[styles.filterBadge, { backgroundColor: colors.primary }]}>
                            <Text style={styles.filterBadgeText}>{activeFilterCount}</Text>
                        </View>
                    )}
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {/* Advanced Filters Panel */}
            {showFilters && (
                <View style={[styles.filtersPanel, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border }]}>
                    {/* Type Filter */}
                    <View style={styles.filterSection}>
                        <Text style={[styles.filterSectionTitle, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Type</Text>
                        <View style={styles.filterChipRow}>
                            {[{ value: 'all', label: 'All' }, { value: 'income', label: 'Income' }, { value: 'spending', label: 'Spending' }, { value: 'move', label: 'Transfer' }].map(opt => (
                                <TouchableOpacity
                                    key={opt.value}
                                    style={[styles.filterChip, { backgroundColor: typeFilter === opt.value ? colors.primaryLight : colors.inputBg, borderColor: typeFilter === opt.value ? colors.primary : colors.border }]}
                                    onPress={() => setTypeFilter(opt.value)}
                                >
                                    <Text style={[styles.filterChipText, { color: typeFilter === opt.value ? colors.primary : colors.textSecondary }]}>{opt.label}</Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>
                            ))}
                        </View>
                    </View>

                    {/* Category Filter */}
                    <View style={styles.filterSection}>
                        <Text style={[styles.filterSectionTitle, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Category</Text>
                        <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={styles.filterChipRow}>
                            {allCategories.map(cat => {
                                const isSelected = categoryFilter.includes(cat.id);
                                return (
                                    <TouchableOpacity
                                        key={cat.id}
                                        style={[styles.filterChip, { backgroundColor: isSelected ? `${cat.color}20` : colors.inputBg, borderColor: isSelected ? cat.color : colors.border }]}
                                        onPress={() => setCategoryFilter(prev => isSelected ? prev.filter(c => c !== cat.id) : [...prev, cat.id])}
                                    >
                                        <Ionicons name={cat.icon} size={12} color={isSelected ? cat.color : colors.textMuted} />
                                        <Text style={[styles.filterChipText, { color: isSelected ? cat.color : colors.textSecondary }]}>{cat.name}</Text>
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                );
                            })}
                        </ScrollView>
                    </View>

                    {/* Amount Range */}
                    <View style={styles.filterSection}>
                        <Text style={[styles.filterSectionTitle, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Amount Range</Text>
                        <View style={styles.amountRangeRow}>
                            <TextInput
                                style={[styles.amountInput, { backgroundColor: colors.inputBg, borderColor: colors.border, color: colors.textPrimary }]}
                                placeholder="Min"
                                placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
                                keyboardType="numeric"
                                value={amountMin}
                                onChangeText={setAmountMin}
                            />
                            <Text style={[{ color: colors.textMuted, fontFamily: 'Poppins_500Medium' }]}>—</Text>
                            <TextInput
                                style={[styles.amountInput, { backgroundColor: colors.inputBg, borderColor: colors.border, color: colors.textPrimary }]}
                                placeholder="Max"
                                placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
                                keyboardType="numeric"
                                value={amountMax}
                                onChangeText={setAmountMax}
                            />
                        </View>
                    </View>



                    {/* Clear All */}
                    {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
                        <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.clearFiltersBtn, { backgroundColor: colors.redLight }]} onPress={clearAllFilters}>
                            <Ionicons name="close-circle-outline" size={14} color={colors.rose} />
                            <Text style={[styles.clearFiltersText, { color: colors.rose }]}>Clear All Filters</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                </View>
            )}

            {/* Sort Chips */}
            <View style={styles.sortRow}>
                <Text style={[styles.sortLabel, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Sort:</Text>
                <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={styles.sortChipRow}>
                    {sortOptions.map((option) => (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                            key={option.value}
                            style={[
                                styles.sortChip,
                                { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border },
                                sortBy === option.value && [styles.sortChipActive, { backgroundColor: colors.primaryLight, borderColor: colors.primary }]
                            ]}
                            onPress={() => setSortBy(option.value)}
                        >
                            <Text style={[
                                styles.sortChipText,
                                { color: colors.textSecondary },
                                sortBy === option.value && [styles.sortChipTextActive, { color: colors.primary }]
                            ]}>
                                {option.label}
                            </Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    ))}
                </ScrollView>
            </View>

            {/* Transaction List */}
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
                <View style={[styles.emptyState, { paddingBottom: 120, paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg }]}>
                    <View style={[styles.emptyIconWrap, { backgroundColor: colors.primaryLight }]}>
                        <Ionicons name="receipt-outline" size={36} color={colors.primary} />
                    </View>
                    <Text style={[styles.emptyTitle, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>No transactions</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.emptyDesc, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>No transactions found for this period</Text>
                </View>
            ) : (
                <FlatList
                    data={filtered}
                    keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
                    showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                    contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 120, paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg }}
                    initialNumToRender={15}
                    maxToRenderPerBatch={10}
                    windowSize={5}
                    renderItem={({ item: transaction }) => {
                        const isMove = transaction.type === 'move';
                        let category = isMove
                            ? { name: 'Transfer', icon: 'swap-horizontal', color: '#6A6FF8' }
                            : getCategoryById(transaction.category);
                        if (transaction.vehicleLogType === 'refuel') category = { ...category, name: 'Car Refuel' };
                        if (transaction.vehicleLogType === 'maintenance') category = { ...category, name: 'Car Maintenance' };
                        const isIncome = transaction.type === 'income';
                        const expanded = expandedId === transaction.id;
                        const asset = transaction.assetId ? assets.find(a => a.id === transaction.assetId) : null;
                        const txOriginalCur = transaction.currency || currency;
                        const originalAmt = formatCurrency(Math.abs(transaction.amount), txOriginalCur);
                        const hasDiffCur = txOriginalCur !== currency;
                        const baseAmt = hasDiffCur ? formatCurrency(Math.abs(convertCurrency(transaction.amount, txOriginalCur, currency, exchangeRates)), currency) : null;

                        return (
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={[styles.txCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}
                                onPress={() => setExpandedId(expanded ? null : transaction.id)}
                                activeOpacity={0.82}
                            >
                                <View style={styles.txMain}>
                                    <View style={[styles.txIcon, { backgroundColor: isDark ? `${category.color}33` : `${category.color}18` }]}>
                                        <Ionicons name={category.icon} size={20} color={category.color} />
                                    </View>
                                    <View style={styles.txInfo}>
                                        <Text style={[styles.txName, { color: colors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                                            {transaction.description || category.name}
                                        </Text>
                                        <Text style={[styles.txMeta, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>{category.name} · {formatTime(transaction.date)}</Text>

                                    </View>
                                    <View style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
                                        <Text style={[styles.txAmount, {
                                            color: isMove ? colors.blue : isIncome ? colors.emerald : colors.rose
                                        }]}>
                                            {isMove ? '⇄ ' : isIncome ? '+' : '-'}{originalAmt}
                                        </Text>
                                        {hasDiffCur && (
                                            <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: colors.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
                                                {baseAmt}
                                            </Text>
                                        )}
                                    </View>
                                </View>

                                {expanded && (
                                    <View style={styles.txExpanded}>
                                        <View style={[styles.txExpandedDivider, { backgroundColor: colors.border }]} />
                                        <Text style={[styles.txDetail, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>📅 {formatDate(transaction.date)}</Text>
                                        {(isMove || (transaction.paymentMethod === 'asset' && asset)) && (
                                            <Text style={[styles.txDetail, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>
                                                {isMove ? '💱 Transfer between accounts' : `💳 ${asset ? asset.name : 'Account'}`}
                                            </Text>
                                        )}
                                        {(transaction.items || []).length > 0 && (
                                            <View style={styles.txItems}>
                                                <Text style={[styles.txDetailLabel, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>Items:</Text>
                                                {transaction.items.map((item, index) => (
                                                    <Text key={`${transaction.id}-${index}`} style={[styles.txDetail, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>
                                                        · {item.name} ×{item.quantity || 1} = {formatCurrency((item.price || 0) * (item.quantity || 1), currency)}
                                                    </Text>
                                                ))}
                                            </View>
                                        )}


                                        <View style={styles.txActions}>
                                            <TouchableOpacity
                                                style={styles.editBtn}
                                                onPress={() => router.push({ pathname: '/add-transaction', params: { editId: transaction.id } })}
                                            >
                                                <Ionicons name="pencil" size={13} color="#6A6FF8" />
                                                <Text style={styles.editTxt}>Edit</Text>
                                            </TouchableOpacity>
                                            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.deleteBtn} onPress={() => confirmDelete(transaction)}>
                                                <Ionicons name="trash" size={13} color="#dc2626" />
                                                <Text style={styles.deleteTxt}>Delete</Text>
                                            </TouchableOpacity>
                                        </View>
                                    </View>
                                )}
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        );
                    }}
                />
            )}

            <DatePickerModal
                visible={showDateModal}
                value={refDate}
                onConfirm={setRefDate}
                onClose={() => setShowDateModal(false)}
                colors={colors}
            />

            {/* Summary Breakdown Modal */}
            <Modal visible={!!showSummaryModal} transparent animationType="fade">
                <View style={styles.smOverlay}>
                    <View style={[styles.smBox, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>

                        {/* Header — matches vehicle modal */}
                        <View style={styles.smHeader}>
                            <View style={[styles.smIconWrap, {
                                backgroundColor: showSummaryModal === 'income' ? 'rgba(5,150,105,0.12)' : 'rgba(220,38,38,0.12)'
                            }]}>
                                <Ionicons
                                    name={showSummaryModal === 'income' ? 'trending-up' : 'trending-down'}
                                    size={20}
                                    color={showSummaryModal === 'income' ? colors.emerald : colors.rose}
                                />
                            </View>
                            <Text style={[styles.smTitle, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>
                                {showSummaryModal === 'income' ? 'Income' : 'Spending'} Breakdown
                            </Text>
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                onPress={() => setShowSummaryModal(null)}
                                style={[styles.smClose, { backgroundColor: colors.inputBg }]}
                            >
                                <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={colors.textSecondary} />
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        </View>

                        {/* Per-currency rows */}
                        {summaryBreakdown.map((item) => (
                            <View key={item.cur} style={[styles.smRow, { borderColor: colors.border }]}>
                                {/* Currency badge */}
                                <View style={[styles.smCurBadge, { backgroundColor: colors.inputBg }]}>
                                    <Text style={[styles.smCurCode, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>{item.cur}</Text>
                                </View>

                                {/* Amounts */}
                                <View style={styles.smAmounts}>
                                    <Text style={[styles.smOriginal, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>
                                        {formatCurrency(item.originalTotal, item.cur)}
                                    </Text>
                                    {item.cur !== currency && (
                                        <View style={styles.smConvRow}>
                                            <Ionicons name="return-down-forward" size={13} color={colors.textMuted} />
                                            <Text style={[styles.smConverted, {
                                                color: showSummaryModal === 'income' ? colors.emerald : colors.rose
                                            }]}>
                                                {formatCurrency(item.convertedTotal, currency)}
                                            </Text>
                                        </View>
                                    )}
                                </View>
                            </View>
                        ))}

                        {/* Total row */}
                        <View style={[styles.smTotalRow, { borderTopColor: colors.border }]}>
                            <Text style={[styles.smTotalLabel, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Total in {currency}</Text>
                            <Text style={[styles.smTotalVal, {
                                color: showSummaryModal === 'income' ? colors.emerald : colors.rose
                            }]}>
                                {formatCurrency(summaryTotal, currency)}
                            </Text>
                        </View>

                        {/* Close button */}
                        <View style={styles.smActions}>
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={[styles.smDoneBtn, { backgroundColor: colors.primary }]}
                                onPress={() => setShowSummaryModal(null)}
                            >
                                <Text style={styles.smDoneTxt}>Done</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        </View>

                    </View>
                </View>
            </Modal>
        </View>
    );
}
