================ FILE: app/log.js ================

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
    View,
    Text,
    StyleSheet,
    TouchableOpacity,
    FlatList,
    TextInput,
    Alert,
    ActivityIndicator,
    Platform,
    ScrollView,
    useWindowDimensions,
} from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Defs, LinearGradient as SvgGrad, Stop, Rect } from 'react-native-svg';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { Spacing, FontSize, BorderRadius } from '../constants/theme';
import { getLogs, clearLogs, exportLogs, subscribeToLogs } from '../services/appLogger';

const CATEGORY_FILTERS = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'All', icon: 'layers-outline' },
    { id: 'transaction', label: 'Transactions', icon: 'receipt-outline' },
    { id: 'asset', label: 'Accounts', icon: 'wallet-outline' },
    { id: 'currency', label: 'Currency', icon: 'cash-outline' },
    { id: 'error', label: 'Errors', icon: 'alert-circle-outline' },
    { id: 'system', label: 'System', icon: 'cog-outline' },
];

export default function LogScreen() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { colors, isDark } = useTheme();
    const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = useWindowDimensions();

    const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
    const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('all');
    const [expandedLogId, setExpandedLogId] = useState(null);
    const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);

    const loadLogsData = useCallback(async () => {
        try {
            const data = await getLogs();
            setLogs(data);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Failed to load logs:', e);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        loadLogsData();
        const unsubscribe = subscribeToLogs((newLogs) => {
            setLogs(newLogs);
        });
        return unsubscribe;
    }, [loadLogsData]);

    const handleClearLogs = () => {
        if (logs.length === 0) return;
        Alert.alert(
            'Clear Activity Logs',
            'Are you sure you want to delete all local activity and system logs? This action cannot be undone.',
            [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                {
                    text: 'Clear All',
                    style: 'destructive',
                    onPress: async () => {
                        await clearLogs();
                        setLogs([]);
                    },
                },
            ]
        );
    };

    const handleExportLogs = async () => {
        if (logs.length === 0) {
            Alert.alert('No Logs', 'There are no logs to export yet.');
            return;
        }
        setIsExporting(true);
        try {
            const result = await exportLogs();
            if (!result.success && result.reason !== 'sharing_unavailable') {
                Alert.alert('Export Failed', result.reason || 'Could not export logs.');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            Alert.alert('Export Error', e.message);
        } finally {
            setIsExporting(false);
        }
    };

    const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
        return logs.filter((log) => {
            // Category filter
            if (selectedCategory !== 'all') {
                if (selectedCategory === 'error' && log.level !== 'error' && log.category !== 'error') {
                    return false;
                } else if (selectedCategory !== 'error' && log.category !== selectedCategory) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            // Search query filter
            if (search.trim()) {
                const query = search.toLowerCase();
                const titleMatch = (log.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
                const detailsMatch = (log.details || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
                const categoryMatch = (log.category || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
                return titleMatch || detailsMatch || categoryMatch;
            }

            return true;
        });
    }, [logs, selectedCategory, search]);

    const getLevelColors = (level, category) => {
        if (level === 'error' || category === 'error') {
            return {
                bg: isDark ? `${colors.spending}22` : `${colors.spending}14`,
                border: `${colors.spending}40`,
                color: colors.spending,
                icon: 'alert-circle',
            };
        }
        if (level === 'warn') {
            return {
                bg: isDark ? `${colors.gold}22` : `${colors.gold}18`,
                border: `${colors.gold}44`,
                color: colors.gold,
                icon: 'warning',
            };
        }
        if (level === 'success') {
            return {
                bg: isDark ? `${colors.income}22` : `${colors.income}16`,
                border: `${colors.income}40`,
                color: colors.income,
                icon: 'checkmark-circle',
            };
        }
        return {
            bg: isDark ? `${colors.blue}22` : `${colors.blue}14`,
            border: `${colors.blue}40`,
            color: colors.blue,
            icon: 'information-circle',
        };
    };

    const getCategoryIcon = (category) => {
        switch (category) {
            case 'transaction':
                return 'receipt-outline';
            case 'asset':
                return 'wallet-outline';
            case 'currency':
                return 'cash-outline';
            case 'settings':
                return 'cog-outline';
            case 'backup':
                return 'cloud-outline';
            case 'ai':
                return 'sparkles-outline';
            case 'error':
                return 'bug-outline';
            default:
                return 'document-text-outline';
        }
    };

    const formatTimestamp = (iso) => {
        if (!iso) return '';
        try {
            const d = new Date(iso);
            return `${d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })} at ${d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' })}`;
        } catch (e) {
            return iso;
        }
    };

    const SectionHeader = ({ icon, color, title }) => (
        <View style={styles.sectionHeader}>
            <View style={[styles.sectionIconWrap, { backgroundColor: `${color}15` }]}>
                <Ionicons name={icon} size={18} color={color} />
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>{title}</Text>
        </View>
    );

    const renderLogItem = ({ item }) => {
        const badge = getLevelColors(item.level, item.category);
        const catIcon = getCategoryIcon(item.category);
        const isExpanded = expandedLogId === item.id;

        return (
            <View style={[styles.logCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                <View style={styles.logMain}>
                    <View style={[styles.logIcon, { backgroundColor: badge.bg }]}>
                        <Ionicons name={catIcon} size={20} color={badge.color} />
                    </View>
                    <View style={styles.logInfo}>
                        <View style={styles.logTitleRow}>
                            <Text style={[styles.logName, { color: colors.textPrimary }]} numberOfLines={1}>
                                {item.title}
                            </Text>
                            <View style={[styles.levelBadge, { backgroundColor: badge.bg, borderColor: badge.border }]}>
                                <Text style={[styles.levelBadgeText, { color: badge.color }]}>
                                    {(item.level || 'info').toUpperCase()}
                                </Text>
                            </View>
                        </View>
                        <Text style={[styles.logMeta, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>
                            {item.category?.toUpperCase()} · {formatTimestamp(item.timestamp)}
                        </Text>
                    </View>
                </View>

                {/* Details text */}
                {!!item.details && (
                    <Text style={[styles.logDetails, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>
                        {item.details}
                    </Text>
                )}

                {/* Stack trace toggle for errors */}
                {!!item.stack && (
                    <View style={styles.stackWrap}>
                        <TouchableOpacity
                            style={[styles.stackToggleBtn, { backgroundColor: colors.inputBg, borderColor: colors.border }]}
                            onPress={() => setExpandedLogId(isExpanded ? null : item.id)}
                            activeOpacity={0.7}
                        >
                            <Ionicons
                                name={isExpanded ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'}
                                size={14}
                                color={colors.primary}
                            />
                            <Text style={[styles.stackToggleText, { color: colors.primary }]}>
                                {isExpanded ? 'Hide Stack Trace' : 'View Stack Trace'}
                            </Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>

                        {isExpanded && (
                            <View style={[styles.stackBox, { backgroundColor: isDark ? '#16171F' : '#F1F3F7', borderColor: colors.border }]}>
                                <Text style={[styles.stackText, { color: colors.textPrimary }]} selectable>
                                    {item.stack}
                                </Text>
                            </View>
                        )}
                    </View>
                )}
            </View>
        );
    };

    return (
        <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]}>
            {/* Background SVG Gradient */}
            <Svg key={colors.background} style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject} width={screenWidth} height={screenHeight} pointerEvents="none">
                <Defs>
                    <SvgGrad id="bgGradLog" x1="0.2" y1="0" x2="0.8" y2="1">
                        <Stop offset="0" stopColor={colors.gradientStart} stopOpacity="1" />
                        <Stop offset="0.5" stopColor={colors.gradientMid} stopOpacity="1" />
                        <Stop offset="1" stopColor={colors.gradientEnd} stopOpacity="1" />
                    </SvgGrad>
                </Defs>
                <Rect x="0" y="0" width={screenWidth} height={screenHeight} fill="url(#bgGradLog)" />
            </Svg>

            {/* Top Navigation Bar */}
            <View style={styles.header}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => router.back()}
                    style={[styles.backBtn, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border, borderWidth: 1 }]}
                    activeOpacity={0.75}
                    accessibilityLabel="Back to settings"
                >
                    <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={colors.primary} />
                </TouchableOpacity>

                <Text style={[styles.title, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>Activity Log</Text>

                <View style={styles.headerActions}>
                    <TouchableOpacity
                        onPress={handleExportLogs}
                        style={[styles.backBtn, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border, borderWidth: 1 }]}
                        activeOpacity={0.75}
                        disabled={isExporting}
                        accessibilityLabel="Export logs"
                    >
                        {isExporting ? (
                            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.primary} />
                        ) : (
                            <Ionicons name="share-outline" size={18} color={colors.primary} />
                        )}
                    </TouchableOpacity>

                    <TouchableOpacity
                        onPress={handleClearLogs}
                        style={[styles.backBtn, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border, borderWidth: 1 }]}
                        activeOpacity={0.75}
                        accessibilityLabel="Clear logs"
                    >
                        <Ionicons
                            name="trash-outline"
                            size={18}
                            color={logs.length > 0 ? (isDark ? '#FF8594' : '#dc2626') : colors.textMuted}
                        />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
            </View>

            {/* Privacy Callout Section */}
            <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg }}>
                <View style={[styles.section, { backgroundColor: colors.card, marginBottom: Spacing.sm }]}>
                    <SectionHeader icon="shield-checkmark" color={colors.emerald} title="100% On-Device & Private" />
                    <Text style={[styles.helperText, { color: colors.textSecondary, marginBottom: 0 }]}>
                        Activity history and diagnostic traces are saved strictly in local sandboxed storage and never transmitted to external servers.
                    </Text>
                </View>
            </View>

            {/* Search Input Box */}
            <View style={styles.searchRow}>
                <View style={[styles.searchBox, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border, borderWidth: 1 }]}>
                    <Ionicons name="search" size={16} color={colors.textSecondary} />
                    <TextInput
                        style={[styles.searchInput, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}
                        placeholder="Search logs, actions, details…"
                        placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
                        value={search}
                        onChangeText={setSearch}
                        autoCorrect={false}
                    />
                    {search ? (
                        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearch('')}>
                            <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color={colors.textSecondary} />
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    ) : null}
                </View>
            </View>

            {/* Filter Chips Row */}
            <View style={styles.filterRow}>
                <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={styles.filterChipRow}>
                    {CATEGORY_FILTERS.map((opt) => {
                        const isSelected = selectedCategory === opt.id;
                        return (
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                key={opt.id}
                                style={[
                                    styles.filterChip,
                                    { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border, borderWidth: 1 },
                                    isSelected && { backgroundColor: colors.primaryLight, borderColor: colors.primary },
                                ]}
                                onPress={() => setSelectedCategory(opt.id)}
                                activeOpacity={0.8}
                            >
                                <Ionicons
                                    name={opt.icon}
                                    size={14}
                                    color={isSelected ? colors.primary : colors.textSecondary}
                                />
                                <Text
                                    style={[
                                        styles.filterChipText,
                                        { color: isSelected ? colors.primary : colors.textSecondary },
                                        isSelected && { fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold' },
                                    ]}
                                >
                                    {opt.label}
                                </Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        );
                    })}
                </ScrollView>
            </View>

            {/* Logs List / Empty State */}
            {loading ? (
                <View style={styles.centerContainer}>
                    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={colors.primary} />
                </View>
            ) : filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
                <View style={styles.emptyState}>
                    <View style={[styles.emptyIconWrap, { backgroundColor: colors.primaryLight }]}>
                        <Ionicons name="receipt-outline" size={38} color={colors.primary} />
                    </View>
                    <Text style={[styles.emptyTitle, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>No Logs Found</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.emptyDesc, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>
                        {search.trim() || selectedCategory !== 'all'
                            ? 'No activity logs match your current search or category filter.'
                            : 'App operations, transactions, accounts, and system diagnostics will automatically appear here.'}
                    </Text>
                </View>
            ) : (
                <FlatList
                    data={filteredLogs}
                    keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
                    renderItem={renderLogItem}
                    contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
                    showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                    initialNumToRender={12}
                    maxToRenderPerBatch={10}
                    windowSize={5}
                />
            )}
        </View>
    );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    container: {
        flex: 1,
    },
    header: {
        flexDirection: 'row',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg,
        paddingTop: 60,
        paddingBottom: Spacing.md,
    },
    backBtn: {
        width: 40,
        height: 40,
        borderRadius: 14,
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
    },
    title: {
        fontSize: FontSize.xl,
        fontFamily: 'Poppins_800ExtraBold',
    },
    headerActions: {
        flexDirection: 'row',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 8,
    },
    section: {
        borderRadius: 22,
        padding: Spacing.lg,
        marginBottom: Spacing.md,
        shadowColor: '#1A1040',
        shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
        shadowOpacity: 0.05,
        shadowRadius: 8,
        elevation: Platform.OS === 'android' ? 0 : 2,
    },
    sectionHeader: {
        flexDirection: 'row',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: Spacing.sm,

================ FILE: app/onboarding.js ================

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
    Platform, View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Alert, KeyboardAvoidingView
} from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Defs, LinearGradient as SvgGrad, Stop, Rect } from 'react-native-svg';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import * as DocumentPicker from 'expo-document-picker';
import { useApp } from '../context/AppContext';
import { generateId } from '../utils/helpers';
import { accountTypes, getAccountTypeById } from '../utils/categories';
import { formatCurrency, currencies, getTopCurrencies, parseCurrencyAmount } from '../utils/currencies';
import { Spacing, FontSize, BorderRadius } from '../constants/theme';
import { importFromJSON, applyImport } from '../services/dataExport';
import FastInput from '../components/FastInput';

const P = '#ff6600';
const E = '#1EC98E';
const CARD = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.90)';
const BG_TOP = '#F7F7F8';
const BG_BOT = '#ECEEF1';
const TEXT = '#151A2D';
const TEXT2 = '#4E566E';
const MUTED = '#8E95AB';
const BORDER = 'rgba(83,96,132,0.14)';

const FEATURES = [
    { icon: 'wallet-outline', color: '#ff6600', title: 'Track Everything', desc: 'Monitor assets, cash, bank accounts, and balances in one central place.' },
    { icon: 'calculator-outline', color: '#1EC98E', title: 'Smart Budgeting', desc: 'Set custom spending limits and keep your budgets perfectly in check.' },
    { icon: 'trending-up-outline', color: '#F59E0B', title: 'Saving Goals', desc: 'Define your saving targets and follow your contribution history visually.' },
    { icon: 'sparkles-outline', color: '#EF4444', title: 'Private Local AI', desc: 'Get intelligent offline financial insights powered by fully secure on-device AI.' },
];

const CARD_COLORS = [
    '#ff6600', '#3B82F6', '#1E293B', '#0F4C75',
    '#059669', '#D97706', '#DC2626', '#DB2777',
    '#7C3AED', '#0891B2', '#9D174D', '#1E3A5F',
];
const DEFAULT_COLORS = ['#ff6600', '#1E3A8A', '#1E293B', '#0F4C75', '#7C3AED', '#9D174D'];
function getCardColor(asset, index) {
    return asset.color || DEFAULT_COLORS[index % DEFAULT_COLORS.length];
}

export default function Onboarding() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { addAsset, addBudget, addSavingGoal, setOnboardingCompleted, currency, setCurrency, loadData, onboardingCompleted, assets: appAssets, transactions: appTransactions } = useApp();

    useEffect(() => {
        if (onboardingCompleted || (appAssets && appAssets.length > 0) || (appTransactions && appTransactions.length > 0)) {
            router.replace('/(tabs)');
        }
    }, [onboardingCompleted, appAssets, appTransactions]);

    const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
    const [agreedToTerms, setAgreedToTerms] = useState(false);
    const [choice, setChoice] = useState(null); // 'new' or 'backup'
    const [selectedCurrency, setSelectedCurrency] = useState(currency || 'USD');
    const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
    const [isFinishing, setIsFinishing] = useState(false);
    const [assets, setAssets] = useState([]);
    const [assetName, setAssetName] = useState('');
    const [assetType, setAssetType] = useState('bank');
    const [assetBalance, setAssetBalance] = useState('');
    const [assetColor, setAssetColor] = useState('#ff6600');
    const [assetCurrency, setAssetCurrency] = useState(currency || 'USD');
    const [showAssetForm, setShowAssetForm] = useState(false);
    const [showAllCurrencies, setShowAllCurrencies] = useState(false);
    const [budgetPeriod, setBudgetPeriod] = useState('monthly');
    const [budgetAmount, setBudgetAmount] = useState('');
    const [goals, setGoals] = useState([]);
    const [showGoalForm, setShowGoalForm] = useState(false);
    const [goalTitle, setGoalTitle] = useState('');
    const [goalAmount, setGoalAmount] = useState('');
    const [goalStart, setGoalStart] = useState('');
    const [goalEnd, setGoalEnd] = useState('');
    const [goalCommitment, setGoalCommitment] = useState('');
    const [goalNotify, setGoalNotify] = useState(false);

    const addLocalGoal = () => {
        const parsedGoalAmt = parseCurrencyAmount(goalAmount, selectedCurrency);
        if (!goalTitle.trim() || parsedGoalAmt <= 0) {
            Alert.alert('Error', 'Please enter a valid goal title and target amount.');
            return;
        }
        if (goalStart && goalEnd && new Date(goalStart) > new Date(goalEnd)) {
            Alert.alert('Error', 'Start date cannot be later than end date.');
            return;
        }
        if (goalNotify && !goalCommitment) {
            Alert.alert('Error', 'Please choose a reminder frequency.');
            return;
        }

        setGoals([...goals, {
            id: generateId(), title: goalTitle.trim(), targetAmount: parsedGoalAmt,
            currentAmount: 0, startDate: goalStart || null, endDate: goalEnd || null,
            commitment: goalCommitment || null, notifyEnabled: goalNotify, savingHistory: [], isCompleted: false,
        }]);
        setGoalTitle(''); setGoalAmount(''); setGoalStart(''); setGoalEnd(''); setGoalCommitment(''); setGoalNotify(false); setShowGoalForm(false);
    };

    const removeLocalGoal = (id) => setGoals(goals.filter(g => g.id !== id));

    const addLocalAsset = () => {
        if (!assetName.trim()) { Alert.alert('Error', 'Enter account name'); return; }
        const bal = parseCurrencyAmount(assetBalance, assetCurrency);
        setAssets([...assets, { id: generateId(), name: assetName.trim(), type: assetType, balance: bal, color: assetColor, currency: assetCurrency }]);
        setAssetName(''); setAssetBalance(''); setAssetType('bank'); setAssetColor('#ff6600'); setAssetCurrency(selectedCurrency); setShowAllCurrencies(false); setShowAssetForm(false);
    };

    const removeLocalAsset = (id) => setAssets(assets.filter(a => a.id !== id));

    const handleImportBackup = async () => {
        try {
            const result = await DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({
                type: 'application/json',
            });
            if (result.canceled) return;
            setImporting(true);
            const file = result.assets[0];
            const importData = await importFromJSON(file.uri);

            let summary = `Found:\n• ${importData.transactions?.length || 0} transactions\n• ${importData.budgets?.length || 0} budgets\n• ${importData.assets?.length || 0} assets`;
            if (importData.savingsGoals?.length > 0) {
                summary += `\n• ${importData.savingsGoals.length} savings goals`;
            }
            if (importData.chatSessions?.length > 0) {
                summary += `\n• ${importData.chatSessions.length} chat sessions`;
            }
            if (importData.settings) {
                summary += `\n• Application appearance & configurations`;
            }
            summary += `\n\nDo you want to import this backup and complete setup?`;

            Alert.alert('Import Backup', summary, [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                {
                    text: 'Import & Go',
                    onPress: async () => {
                        try {
                            const counts = await applyImport(importData, true);
                            await loadData();
                            await setOnboardingCompleted();

                            let doneMsg = `Imported ${counts.transactions} transactions, ${counts.budgets} budgets, ${counts.assets} assets.`;
                            if (counts.savingsGoals > 0 || counts.chatSessions > 0) {
                                doneMsg += `\nIncluded ${counts.savingsGoals || 0} savings goals and ${counts.chatSessions || 0} chat sessions.`;
                            }
                            doneMsg += `\n\nSettings and data restored successfully!`;

                            Alert.alert('Done', doneMsg, [
                                {
                                    text: 'Awesome',
                                    onPress: () => {
                                        router.replace('/(tabs)');
                                    }
                                }
                            ]);
                        } catch (e) {
                            console.error(e);
                            Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to restore backup: ' + e.message);
                        }
                    },
                },
            ]);
        } catch (err) {
            Alert.alert('Error', err.message);
        } finally {
            setImporting(false);
        }
    };

    const handleFinish = async () => {
        if (isFinishing) return;
        setIsFinishing(true);
        try {
            for (const a of assets) await addAsset(a);
            const amt = parseCurrencyAmount(budgetAmount, selectedCurrency);
            if (amt > 0) await addBudget({ id: generateId(), period: budgetPeriod, amount: amt });
            for (const g of goals) {
                await addSavingGoal(g);
            }
            await setOnboardingCompleted();
            router.replace('/(tabs)');
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            Alert.alert('Error', 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
            setIsFinishing(false);
        }
    };

    const canNext = () => {
        if (step === 0) return true;
        if (step === 1) return agreedToTerms; // Must agree to Terms, AI Disclaimer & No-Warranty clause
        if (step === 2) return choice === 'new';
        if (step === 3) return !!selectedCurrency;
        return true;
    };

    const nextStep = () => {
        if (step === 1 && !agreedToTerms) {
            Alert.alert('Agreement Required', 'Please review and agree to the Terms of Use, AI Disclaimer, and Data Loss Policy to continue.');
            return;
        }
        if (step === 2 && choice === 'backup') {
            Alert.alert('Import Backup', 'Please import your backup file below to restore your data, or select "I\'m New Here" to start fresh.');
            return;
        }
        if (!canNext()) { Alert.alert('', 'Please make a selection'); return; }

        if (step === 3) {
            setCurrency(selectedCurrency);
        }

        if (step < 6) setStep(step + 1); else handleFinish();
    };

    return (
        <KeyboardAvoidingView style={s.root} behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}>
            <Svg style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject} pointerEvents="none">
                <Defs>
                    <SvgGrad id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                        <Stop offset="0" stopColor={BG_TOP} stopOpacity="1" />
                        <Stop offset="1" stopColor={BG_BOT} stopOpacity="1" />
                    </SvgGrad>
                </Defs>
                <Rect x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#bg)" />
            </Svg>

            <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={s.scroll}>
                {/* ── Step 0: Welcome ── */}
                {step === 0 && (
                    <View style={s.stepWrapWelcome}>
                        <View style={s.logoWrap}>
                            <View style={s.logoCircle}>
                                <Ionicons name="trending-up" size={36} color="#fff" />
                            </View>
                        </View>
                        <Text style={s.heading}>Welcome to FinanceFlow</Text>
                        <Text style={s.sub}>Your all-in-one private personal finance tracker.</Text>

                        <View style={s.featuresList}>
                            {FEATURES.map((f, i) => (
                                <View key={i} style={s.featureRow}>
                                    <View style={[s.featureIconWrap, { backgroundColor: f.color + '18' }]}>
                                        <Ionicons name={f.icon} size={24} color={f.color} />
                                    </View>
                                    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                        <Text style={s.featureTitle}>{f.title}</Text>
                                        <Text style={s.featureDesc}>{f.desc}</Text>
                                    </View>
                                </View>
                            ))}
                        </View>
                    </View>
                )}

                {/* ── Step 1: Privacy, AI Disclaimer & No-Warranty Terms ── */}
                {step === 1 && (
                    <View style={s.stepWrapIntro}>
                        <Text style={s.heading}>Terms & Disclaimers</Text>
                        <Text style={s.sub}>Please review and accept our privacy, AI, and data storage terms before using FinanceFlow.</Text>

                        <View style={s.featuresList}>
                            <View style={s.featureRow}>
                                <View style={[s.featureIconWrap, { backgroundColor: '#10B98118' }]}>
                                    <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark" size={24} color="#10B981" />
                                </View>
                                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                    <Text style={s.featureTitle}>100% Local & Private Data</Text>
                                    <Text style={s.featureDesc}>All financial records, accounts, and transactions are stored locally on your device. Internet is used only for anonymous currency exchange rates and optional AI model downloads.</Text>
                                </View>
                            </View>

                            <View style={s.featureRow}>
                                <View style={[s.featureIconWrap, { backgroundColor: '#EF444418' }]}>
                                    <Ionicons name="alert-circle" size={24} color="#EF4444" />
                                </View>
                                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                    <Text style={s.featureTitle}>Not Financial Advice (AI Disclaimer)</Text>
                                    <Text style={s.featureDesc}>All content, scores, and insights generated by the AI Assistant, Financial Health analyzer, and OCR/PDF tools are for informational and educational purposes only and do NOT constitute certified financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. AI outputs may contain errors or inaccuracies. Always consult a qualified financial professional before making financial decisions.</Text>
                                </View>
                            </View>

                            <View style={s.featureRow}>
                                <View style={[s.featureIconWrap, { backgroundColor: '#F59E0B18' }]}>
                                    <Ionicons name="warning" size={24} color="#F59E0B" />
                                </View>
                                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                    <Text style={s.featureTitle}>"As-Is" / No Warranty for Data Loss</Text>
                                    <Text style={s.featureDesc}>FinanceFlow is provided "AS IS" without warranties of any kind. Because all data is stored locally on your device without cloud synchronization, the developer is not responsible or liable for any data loss, corruption, or financial discrepancy resulting from device loss, hardware damage, OS updates, or app uninstallation. You are solely responsible for exporting regular backups via Settings.</Text>
                                </View>
                            </View>
                        </View>

                        <TouchableOpacity
                            style={[
                                s.agreeBox,
                                agreedToTerms && { borderColor: P, backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,102,0,0.08)' }
                            ]}
                            onPress={() => setAgreedToTerms(!agreedToTerms)}
                            activeOpacity={0.8}
                        >
                            <View style={[s.checkbox, agreedToTerms && { backgroundColor: P, borderColor: P }]}>
                                {agreedToTerms && <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={14} color="#fff" />}
                            </View>
                            <Text style={s.agreeText}>
                                I have read, understood, and agree to the <Text style={{ fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold', color: TEXT }}>Not Financial Advice Disclaimer</Text>, the <Text style={{ fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold', color: TEXT }}>"As-Is" No Warranty Clause for Data Loss</Text>, and the <Text style={{ fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold', color: TEXT }}>Privacy Policy</Text>.
                            </Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                )}

                {/* ── Step 2: Getting Started Choice ── */}
                {step === 2 && (
                    <View style={s.stepWrapIntro}>
                        <Text style={s.heading}>How would you like to start?</Text>
                        <Text style={s.sub}>Choose whether you are starting fresh or restoring an existing backup file.</Text>

                        <View style={s.choiceContainer}>
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={[s.choiceCard, choice === 'new' && { borderColor: P, backgroundColor: P + '08' }]}
                                onPress={() => setChoice('new')}
                                activeOpacity={0.8}>
                                <View style={[s.choiceHeader, { backgroundColor: P + '12' }]}>
                                    <Ionicons name="sparkles" size={24} color={P} />
                                </View>
                                <Text style={s.choiceTitle}>I'm New Here</Text>
                                <Text style={s.choiceDesc}>Set up your accounts, set budgets, and savings goals step-by-step.</Text>
                                {choice === 'new' && (
                                    <View style={s.activeBadge}>
                                        <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={20} color={P} />
                                    </View>
                                )}
                            </TouchableOpacity>

                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={[s.choiceCard, choice === 'backup' && { borderColor: E, backgroundColor: E + '08' }]}
                                onPress={() => setChoice('backup')}
                                activeOpacity={0.8}>
                                <View style={[s.choiceHeader, { backgroundColor: E + '12' }]}>
                                    <Ionicons name="cloud-upload" size={24} color={E} />
                                </View>
                                <Text style={s.choiceTitle}>Restore Backup</Text>
                                <Text style={s.choiceDesc}>Instantly import a backup file to restore all your data and settings.</Text>
                                {choice === 'backup' && (
                                    <View style={s.activeBadge}>
                                        <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={20} color={E} />
                                    </View>
                                )}
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        </View>

                        {choice === 'new' && (
                            <View style={s.infoBox}>
                                <Ionicons name="information-circle" size={20} color={P} style={{ marginTop: 2 }} />
                                <Text style={s.infoText}>
                                    Great choice! Let's get you set up. Tap <Text style={{ fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold' }}>Next</Text> to start adding your bank accounts and assets.
                                </Text>
                            </View>
                        )}

                        {choice === 'backup' && (
                            <View style={s.importBox}>
                                <Text style={s.importText}>
                                    Import your <Text style={{ fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold' }}>JSON backup file</Text> to recover transactions, assets, budgets, savings goals, chat history, and settings.
                                </Text>
                                <TouchableOpacity style={s.importBtn} onPress={handleImportBackup} disabled={importing} activeOpacity={0.85}>
                                    <Ionicons name="document-text" size={20} color="#fff" />
                                    <Text style={s.importBtnText}>
                                        {importing ? 'Importing Backup...' : 'Select Backup File'}
                                    </Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>
                            </View>
                        )}
                    </View>
                )}

                {/* ── Step 3: Currency Selection ── */}
                {step === 3 && (
                    <View>
                        <Text style={s.heading}>Select Default Currency</Text>
                        <Text style={s.sub}>Choose the primary currency you'd like to use in FinanceFlow. You can change this later in Settings.</Text>

                        <View style={{ marginTop: Spacing.md, gap: Spacing.sm }}>
                            {currencies.map(c => (
                                <TouchableOpacity key={c.code}
                                    style={[s.choiceCard, { minHeight: 'auto', flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'flex-start' }, selectedCurrency === c.code && { borderColor: P, backgroundColor: P + '08' }]}
                                    onPress={() => setSelectedCurrency(c.code)}
                                    activeOpacity={0.8}>
                                    <View style={[s.choiceHeader, { marginBottom: 0, marginRight: Spacing.md, backgroundColor: selectedCurrency === c.code ? P : CARD, borderWidth: selectedCurrency === c.code ? 0 : 1, borderColor: BORDER }]}>
                                        <Text style={{ fontSize: 18, color: selectedCurrency === c.code ? '#fff' : TEXT }}>{c.symbol}</Text>
                                    </View>
                                    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                        <Text style={[s.choiceTitle, { textAlign: 'left', marginBottom: 0 }]}>{c.code}</Text>
                                        <Text style={[s.choiceDesc, { textAlign: 'left' }]}>{c.name}</Text>
                                    </View>
                                    {selectedCurrency === c.code && <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={20} color={P} />}
                                </TouchableOpacity>
                            ))}
                        </View>
                    </View>
                )}

                {/* ── Step 4: Accounts ── */}
                {step === 4 && (
                    <View>
                        <Text style={s.heading}>Add Your Accounts</Text>
                        <Text style={s.sub}>Add your bank accounts, wallets, and cash to get started.</Text>
                        {assets.map((a, index) => {
                            const at = getAccountTypeById(a.type);
                            const cardColor = getCardColor(a, index);
                            return (
                                <View key={a.id} style={[s.atmCard, { backgroundColor: cardColor, shadowColor: '#1A1040' }]}>
                                    <View style={s.atmCardTop}>
                                        <View style={s.chip}>
                                            <View style={s.chipLine} />
                                            <View style={s.chipLine} />
                                        </View>
                                        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: Spacing.sm }}>
                                            <Ionicons name={at.icon} size={22} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)" />
                                            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => removeLocalAsset(a.id)} style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)', borderRadius: 12, padding: 4 }}>
                                                <Ionicons name="close" size={16} color="#fff" />
                                            </TouchableOpacity>
                                        </View>
                                    </View>
                                    <Text style={s.atmCardName} numberOfLines={1}>{a.name}</Text>
                                    <Text style={[s.atmCardBalance, { color: a.balance >= 0 ? '#fff' : '#FFB3BA' }]}>
                                        {formatCurrency(a.balance, a.currency || currency)}
                                    </Text>
                                </View>
                            );
                        })}
                        {!showAssetForm ? (
                            <TouchableOpacity style={s.addBtn} onPress={() => { setAssetCurrency(selectedCurrency); setShowAllCurrencies(false); setShowAssetForm(true); }}>
                                <Ionicons name="add-circle-outline" size={20} color={P} />
                                <Text style={[s.addBtnText, { color: P }]}>Add Account</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        ) : (
                            <View style={s.formCard}>
                                <View style={[s.cardPreview, { backgroundColor: assetColor }]}>
                                    <View style={s.previewTop}>
                                        <View style={s.chip}>
                                            <View style={s.chipLine} />
                                            <View style={s.chipLine} />
                                        </View>
                                        <Ionicons name={getAccountTypeById(assetType).icon} size={20} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)" />
                                    </View>
                                    <Text style={s.previewName} numberOfLines={1}>
                                        {assetName || 'Account Name'}
                                    </Text>
                                    <Text style={s.previewBalance}>
                                        {formatCurrency(parseCurrencyAmount(assetBalance, assetCurrency), assetCurrency)}
                                    </Text>
                                    <Text style={s.previewType}>{getAccountTypeById(assetType).name}</Text>
                                </View>

                                <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Account Name</Text>
                                <FastInput style={s.input} placeholder="e.g. Savings Account" placeholderTextColor={MUTED}
                                    value={assetName} onChangeText={setAssetName} />
                                <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Type</Text>
                                <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} style={{ marginBottom: Spacing.md }}>
                                    {accountTypes.map(t => (
                                        <TouchableOpacity key={t.id}
                                            style={[s.typeChip, assetType === t.id && s.typeChipActive]}
                                            onPress={() => setAssetType(t.id)}>
                                            <Ionicons name={t.icon} size={14} color={assetType === t.id ? '#fff' : P} />
                                            <Text style={[s.typeChipText, assetType === t.id && { color: '#fff' }]}>{t.name}</Text>
                                        </TouchableOpacity>
                                    ))}
                                </ScrollView>
                                <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Card Color</Text>
                                <View style={s.colorPicker}>
                                    {CARD_COLORS.map(c => (
                                        <TouchableOpacity
                                            key={c}
                                            style={[s.colorSwatch, { backgroundColor: c }, assetColor === c && s.colorSwatchSelected]}
                                            onPress={() => setAssetColor(c)}
                                        />
                                    ))}
                                </View>
                                <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Account Currency</Text>
                                <View style={s.currencyGrid}>
                                    {(showAllCurrencies ? currencies : getTopCurrencies(selectedCurrency, assetCurrency)).map(c => (
                                        <TouchableOpacity
                                            key={c.code}
                                            style={[
                                                s.currencyOption,
                                                { backgroundColor: CARD, borderColor: BORDER },
                                                assetCurrency === c.code && [s.currencyActive, { borderColor: P, backgroundColor: P + '18' }],
                                            ]}
                                            onPress={() => setAssetCurrency(c.code)}
                                            activeOpacity={0.8}
                                        >
                                            <Text style={[s.currencyCode, { color: TEXT2 }, assetCurrency === c.code && [s.currencyCodeActive, { color: P }]]}>{c.code}</Text>
                                            <Text style={[s.currencySymbol, { color: MUTED }, assetCurrency === c.code && [s.currencySymbolActive, { color: P }]]}>{c.symbol}</Text>
                                        </TouchableOpacity>
                                    ))}
                                    {!showAllCurrencies && (
                                        <TouchableOpacity
                                            style={[s.currencyOption, { backgroundColor: CARD, borderColor: BORDER }]}
                                            onPress={() => setShowAllCurrencies(true)}>
                                            <Ionicons name="ellipsis-horizontal" size={20} color={TEXT2} />
                                            <Text style={[s.currencySymbol, { color: MUTED }]}>Other</Text>
                                        </TouchableOpacity>
                                    )}
                                </View>
                                <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Balance ({assetCurrency})</Text>
                                <FastInput style={s.input} placeholder="0" placeholderTextColor={MUTED}
                                    value={assetBalance} onChangeText={setAssetBalance} keyboardType="numeric" />
                                <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: Spacing.sm, marginTop: Spacing.sm }}>
                                    <TouchableOpacity style={[s.formBtn, { flex: 1, backgroundColor: CARD, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: BORDER }]}
                                        onPress={() => requestAnimationFrame(() => setShowAssetForm(false))}>
                                        <Text style={{ color: TEXT2, fontFamily: 'Poppins_600SemiBold' }}>Cancel</Text>
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                    <TouchableOpacity style={[s.formBtn, { flex: 2, backgroundColor: P }]} onPress={addLocalAsset}>
                                        <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold' }}>Add Account</Text>
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                </View>
                            </View>
                        )}
                        <Text style={s.skipNote}>You can add more accounts later in the Assets tab.</Text>
                    </View>
                )}

                {/* ── Step 5: Budget ── */}
                {step === 5 && (
                    <View>
                        <Text style={s.heading}>Set Your Budget</Text>
                        <Text style={s.sub}>Set a spending limit to keep your finances on track.</Text>
                        <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Budget Period</Text>
                        <View style={s.periodRow}>
                            {['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly'].map(p => (
                                <TouchableOpacity key={p}
                                    style={[s.periodChip, budgetPeriod === p && s.periodChipActive]}
                                    onPress={() => setBudgetPeriod(p)}>
                                    <Text style={[s.periodChipText, budgetPeriod === p && { color: '#fff' }]}>
                                        {p.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + p.slice(1)}
                                    </Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>
                            ))}
                        </View>
                        <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Spending Limit ({selectedCurrency})</Text>
                        <FastInput style={[s.input, s.bigInput]} placeholder="0" placeholderTextColor={MUTED}
                            value={budgetAmount} onChangeText={setBudgetAmount} keyboardType="numeric" />
                        <Text style={s.skipNote}>You can skip this and set a budget later in the Budget tab.</Text>
                    </View>
                )}

                {/* ── Step 6: Saving Goals ── */}
                {step === 6 && (
                    <View>
                        <Text style={s.heading}>Create Saving Goals</Text>
                        <Text style={s.sub}>Start working towards something meaningful. Add your financial targets.</Text>

                        {goals.map((g, index) => (
                            <View key={g.id} style={[s.atmCard, { backgroundColor: getCardColor(g, index), shadowColor: '#1A1040', marginBottom: 12 }]}>
                                <View style={s.atmCardTop}>
                                    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: Spacing.sm }}>
                                        <Ionicons name="flag" size={22} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.7)" />
                                        <Text style={[s.atmCardName, { marginLeft: 0 }]} numberOfLines={1}>{g.title}</Text>
                                    </View>
                                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => removeLocalGoal(g.id)} style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)', borderRadius: 12, padding: 4 }}>
                                        <Ionicons name="close" size={16} color="#fff" />
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                </View>
                                <Text style={s.atmCardBalance}>
                                    {formatCurrency(g.targetAmount, selectedCurrency)}
                                </Text>
                                {g.endDate && (
                                    <Text style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)', fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'Poppins_500Medium', marginTop: 4 }}>
                                        Target: {g.endDate}
                                    </Text>
                                )}
                            </View>
                        ))}

                        {!showGoalForm ? (
                            <TouchableOpacity style={s.addBtn} onPress={() => setShowGoalForm(true)}>
                                <Ionicons name="add-circle-outline" size={20} color={P} />
                                <Text style={[s.addBtnText, { color: P }]}>Add New Goal</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        ) : (
                            <View style={s.formCard}>
                                <Text style={s.inputLabel}>What is this saving for?</Text>
                                <FastInput style={s.input} placeholder="e.g. Buy a new PC" placeholderTextColor={MUTED}
                                    value={goalTitle} onChangeText={setGoalTitle} />
                                <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Target Amount ({selectedCurrency})</Text>
                                <FastInput style={s.input} placeholder="0" placeholderTextColor={MUTED}
                                    value={goalAmount} onChangeText={setGoalAmount} keyboardType="numeric" />
                                <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: Spacing.sm }}>
                                    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                        <Text style={s.inputLabel}>Start Date</Text>
                                        <FastInput style={s.input} placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" placeholderTextColor={MUTED}
                                            value={goalStart} onChangeText={setGoalStart} />
                                    </View>
                                    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                        <Text style={s.inputLabel}>End Date</Text>
                                        <FastInput style={s.input} placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" placeholderTextColor={MUTED}
                                            value={goalEnd} onChangeText={setGoalEnd} />
                                    </View>
                                </View>
                                <View style={s.commitBox}>
                                    <TouchableOpacity style={s.checkRow} onPress={() => setGoalNotify(!goalNotify)}>
                                        <View style={[s.checkbox, goalNotify && { backgroundColor: E, borderColor: E }]}>
                                            {goalNotify && <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={12} color="#fff" />}
                                        </View>
                                        <Text style={s.checkLabel}>I commit to add savings regularly — send me reminders</Text>
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                    {goalNotify && (
                                        <View style={[s.periodRow, { marginTop: Spacing.sm }]}>
                                            {['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly'].map(p => (
                                                <TouchableOpacity key={p}
                                                    style={[s.periodChip, goalCommitment === p && s.periodChipActive]}
                                                    onPress={() => setGoalCommitment(p)}>
                                                    <Text style={[s.periodChipText, goalCommitment === p && { color: '#fff' }]}>
                                                        {p.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + p.slice(1)}
                                                    </Text>
                                                </TouchableOpacity>
                                            ))}
                                        </View>
                                    )}
                                </View>
                                <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: Spacing.sm, marginTop: Spacing.md }}>
                                    <TouchableOpacity style={[s.formBtn, { flex: 1, backgroundColor: CARD, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: BORDER }]}
                                        onPress={() => requestAnimationFrame(() => setShowGoalForm(false))}>
                                        <Text style={{ color: TEXT2, fontFamily: 'Poppins_600SemiBold' }}>Cancel</Text>
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                    <TouchableOpacity style={[s.formBtn, { flex: 2, backgroundColor: P }]} onPress={addLocalGoal}>
                                        <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontFamily: 'Poppins_700Bold' }}>Save Goal</Text>
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                </View>
                            </View>
                        )}
                    </View>
                )}
            </ScrollView>

            {/* Navigation */}
            <View style={s.nav}>
                {step > 0 ? (
                    <TouchableOpacity style={s.backBtn} onPress={() => setStep(step - 1)}>
                        <Ionicons name="chevron-back" size={18} color={TEXT2} />
                        <Text style={s.backBtnText}>Back</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                ) : <View style={{ flex: 1 }} />}
                <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[s.nextBtn, (!canNext() || isFinishing) && { opacity: 0.5 }]}
                    disabled={isFinishing}
                    onPress={nextStep}>
                    <Text style={s.nextBtnText}>
                        {step === 1 ? 'Agree & Continue' : step === 6 ? 'Get Started' : 'Next'}
                    </Text>
                    <Ionicons name={step === 6 || step === 1 ? 'checkmark' : 'chevron-forward'} size={18} color="#fff" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    );
}
